STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked leafy greens ~25 kcal/100 g (sautéed with a little oil would be higher, but the oil is only ~1 g here). Greens: 43 g x 25 = 11 kcal. Oil: 1 g x 880 = 9 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A modest pile of wilted greens filling about a fifth of a dinner plate at ~40 g and ~20 kcal is plausible. Total ≈ 44 g, ≈ 20 kcal.
